scoring_justification: Checker interpolates the agent's raw power factor vs. Seebeck coefficient data at 200 μV/K to compute the reduction ratio and rank order, comparing against paper-derived thresholds.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden thresholds for power factor reduction ratio and ordering condition derived from paper's claim.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'when the impurity band is at the edge of the main band the power factor is reduced by about 30%' and 'power factor is marginally greater...4kT...marginally less...kT'. Fig. 5.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from the paper's stated 30% reduction and relative ordering description.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own quantitative claims.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the power factor versus Seebeck coefficient for each impurity band depth (none, 0, kT, 4kT).

output_contract.notes: Power factor is in arbitrary units, so only relative reductions and ordering are meaningful. The checker will interpolate at a specific Seebeck coefficient to verify the paper's numerical claim.

steps.description: Interpolate power factor at Seebeck=200 μV/K for no-impurity-band and E_I=0 cases, compute ratio, check it is within [0.65, 0.75].
At Seebeck=200 μV/K, verify the power factor ordering: 4kT > none > kT > 0.
